direction: Warm record-store editorial; selected under delegated design scope after optional direction question.

assets.prompt: Create a premium editorial photograph for Lyra, a personal music library application. Standalone image asset, no UI, no text, no logos. Landscape 3:2 composition. A tactile black vinyl record halfway out of an unprinted burnt-orange record sleeve on a cream linen surface, a small walnut speaker and the edge of a vintage turntable at upper right, warm afternoon window light, long soft shadows. Close overhead still-life crop, strong diagonals, analog film grain, quiet intimate listening-room mood, art-directed contemporary record-store magazine. Palette warm ivory #f4efe5, near-black #262522, copper #a34127, walnut. Keep vinyl entirely readable, sleeve empty. No people, no floating objects, no shiny plastic 3d look, no collage.

assets.prompt: A single original minimalist brand symbol for Lyra, a warm editorial personal music library: three elegantly curved parallel copper lines suggesting both a lyre string instrument and the grooves of a vinyl record, joined by one simple baseline into an abstract lowercase l-shaped music glyph. Flat ink print, near-black #262522 only, no gradients, no shadow, no wording or letters, no frame, no extra elements. Strong silhouette, centered with moderate clear padding. Square format. Transparent background. Precise editorial identity for a record-store magazine, calm and distinctive.
